record.context_brief: Zero entropy versus sequential commutation complexity
record.original_question: Does there exist a II_1 factor N with 1-bounded entropy h(N)=0 but continuum many sequential commutation orbits of Haar unitaries? Also, does there exist a II_1 factor N with h(N)=0 that is not generated, as a von Neumann algebra, by a single sequential commutation orbit?

evidence.quote: Problem 26. Does there exist a II1 factor N satisfying h(N) = 0 but N has continuum many sequential commutation orbits? Secondly does there exist a II1 factor N such that h(N) = 0, and N is not generated as a von Neumann algebra by a single sequential commutation orbit?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $N$ be a separable II$_1$ factor with normal faithful trace $	au$ and let $U(N)$ denote its unitary group. Recall Hayes's 1-bounded entropy $h(N)\in\{-\infty\}\cup[0,\infty]$, an invariant of the von Neumann algebra $N$ (independent of the choice of generators) defined via microstate spaces in free probability; in particular $h(N)=0$ holds for many "rigid" examples (e.g. property (T) factors, factors with diffuse property Gamma, etc.).

For a Haar unitary $u\in N$ (i.e., a unitary whose spectral distribution under $	au$ is the uniform measure on the unit circle), define the sequential commutation orbit of $u$ to be the set
$$\mathrm{SC}(u)=\{v\in U(N):v	ext{ is a Haar unitary and there exist Haar unitaries }u=u_0,u_1,\dots,u_n=v	ext{ in }N	ext{ with }[u_{i-1},u_i]=0	ext{ for }i=1,\dots,n\}.$$
Two Haar unitaries $u,v$ are said to lie in the same sequential commutation orbit if $v\in\mathrm{SC}(u)$; this defines an equivalence relation on the set of Haar unitaries of $N$.

Answer the following two questions:

(a) Does there exist a II$_1$ factor $N$ with $h(N)=0$ such that the set of Haar unitaries of $N$ has continuum many distinct sequential commutation orbits?

(b) Does there exist a II$_1$ factor $N$ with $h(N)=0$ such that $N$ is not generated, as a von Neumann algebra, by a single sequential commutation orbit $\mathrm{SC}(u)$ of some Haar unitary $u\in N$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicitly unresolved problem in a recent open-problems compilation on ultraproduct II$_1$ factors (2025). No published resolution was located; the problem appears open.
